module_title: Intermolecular Forces, Capillarity, and Hooke's Law
introduction: To understand why liquids behave the way they do, we must look at the magnetic-like forces between their molecules. This level explains why water climbs up a towel and how temperature affects fluids.

core_concepts.title: Cohesive and Adhesive Forces
core_concepts.description:
1. Cohesive Force: The force of attraction between molecules of the 'SAME' substance (e.g., water-water attraction). 
2. Adhesive Force: The force of attraction between molecules of 'DIFFERENT' substances (e.g., water-glass attraction).

core_concepts.title: Capillarity (Capillary Action)
core_concepts.description:
The phenomenon of the rise or fall of a liquid in a very narrow, hair-like tube (capillary tube) is called capillarity. 
Practical Examples: 
1. Oil rising in the wick of a kerosene lamp. 
2. Ink rising in blotting paper. 
3. Roots of trees pulling water up from the soil.

core_concepts.title: Effect of Temperature on Liquids
core_concepts.description:
When a liquid is heated: 
1. Surface Tension 'decreases'. (This is why hot water washes clothes better; it spreads easily). 
2. Viscosity 'decreases'. (Hot honey flows faster than cold honey).

core_concepts.title: Hooke's Law
core_concepts.description:
Within the elastic limit, the Stress applied to a body is directly proportional to the Strain produced. 
$Stress \propto Strain$ 
Therefore, $Stress / Strain = E$ (Modulus of Elasticity).

important_entities.name: Hot Soup Tastes Better
important_entities.significance: Why does hot soup taste better than cold soup? Because increasing temperature lowers surface tension. The hot soup spreads out perfectly over the entire tongue, reaching all the taste buds.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: While the viscosity of liquids DECREASES with a rise in temperature, the viscosity of gases actually INCREASES. This is because heating a gas causes more random molecular collisions, increasing friction.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: CO-workers = Same company, AD-ditions = Different things
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Cohesive = Same molecules. Adhesive = Different molecules.

exam_strategy_tips: A very common NDA question: 'Why is it recommended to plow fields after rain?' Answer: To break the 'capillary tubes' in the soil, preventing underground moisture from rising and evaporating.
